store_path.description: Path to the client state directory (stores images, aliases, logs, etc.).

default_remote.description: Default Incus remote to use when none is specified (e.g., `local`, `images`, `incus`).

server_url.description: Full server URL (e.g., `https://my.incus.server:8443`) — only needed for unnamed remotes.

networked.description: Whether to use network communication. Set to false to force local socket usage.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug output for troubleshooting.

aliases.description: Custom command aliases (key = alias name, value = command to run).

auto_update_images.description: Whether to automatically update cached images from remote servers.

trusted_image_fingerprints.description: List of trusted image server fingerprints to skip prompt on first use (e.g., for private image servers).

items.description: A SHA256 fingerprint of an image server certificate (e.g., `a1b2c3d4...`).

default_disk_devices.description: Named disk device templates to reuse when launching containers/VMs.

source.description: Source path or device (e.g., `default` pool volume name, or `/var/incus/disks/myvol`).

profiles.description: Default profiles to apply to new instances (profiles define device inheritance, security, resources, etc.).

name.description: Name of the profile (must match an existing profile name).
